overview: The Board of Assessors approved minutes and motor vehicle abatements, reviewed the annual boat excise commitment, and approved the second round of personal tax exemptions. The Board also received an update on the fiscal year 2027 valuation metrics before entering executive session.

items.title: August 12th Minutes and Motor Vehicle Abatements
items.summary: Approved the minutes of the August 12th meeting and reviewed the motor vehicle abatements.

items.title: Boat Excise Commitment
items.summary: Reviewed the annual boat excise commitment for the city's two marinas.

items.title: Personal Exemptions Round Two
items.summary: Approved all second-round personal tax exemptions, which included applications for disabled veterans, surviving spouses, CPA surcharges, blindness, and low-income seniors.

items.title: Fiscal Year 2027 Valuation Update
items.summary: Received a market update on property valuations, noting average increases of 3% for single-family homes, 6% for two-family homes, 1% to 2% for condominiums, and 6% to 7% for three-family homes.
